post_topic: Showing Signal: dead integration still live in production copy, and attribution data that was never actually being captured
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A clean flow diagram titled "What Gets Missed Without a Build Audit" in bold at the top. The diagram shows a single left-to-right pipeline with three labeled stages arranged horizontally: a box on the left labeled "Signup / Checkout Flow" with a small user icon, connected by a right-pointing arrow to a box in the center labeled "Attribution Capture Layer" marked with a red dashed border and a small warning triangle icon labeled "Gap: never wired", connected by a right-pointing arrow to a box on the right labeled "Backend Attribution Store" with a database cylinder icon and a small green checkmark labeled "Supported since earlier build". Below the center box, a separate downward arrow points to a dead-end node labeled "LionDesk CRM" with a strikethrough and the text "Vendor shutdown" beneath it in small italic text. A callout box in amber floats above the pipeline reading: "10 files still referenced it as live." The overall layout is horizontal, single-row, minimal, with generous whitespace.

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text "Kelvin Davis" bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
